secrets.name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
secrets.description: Password for the /admin schedule console (authenticates POST to /api/schedule). Optional — the main schedule views work without it.

secrets.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
secrets.description: Fine-grained GitHub token with Contents: read+write on gageabass-jpg/publicworx, used by the admin console to publish schedule changes. Optional — only needed for the /admin publish workflow.
